source.public_versification_note: Public 25:1–18, 26:2–65, 27–28 and 29:1–39 align directly. Public 26:1 combines Hebrew 25:19 and 26:1, each bound separately in source_segments. Public 29:40 maps to Hebrew 30:1; public 30:1–16 maps to Hebrew 30:2–17. All 194 original records are hashed exactly for 193 public verses.

key_decisions.decision: Retains the exact date, work category and teruah sound; does not specify an instrument absent from this verse.
Keeps both overlapping monthly and daily obligations; the festival offering replaces neither.
Retains tenth-day date and self-affliction language without reducing it only to fasting; distinguishes the ban on all work from ordinary work.
Preserves the distinction between this goat, the atonement sin offering and daily offerings rather than merging the ritual categories.
Preserves the narrative conclusion in public chapter 29 while binding its exact source record, Hebrew 30:1.
